nate (devex): quick sync — we're seeing three recurring issues from customers: (1) edge samples error with 'require is not defined', (2) TypeScript can't resolve types with conditional exports, (3) slight auth/retry semantic drift between bundles. thinking we need a publish RFC to standardize.

priya (pkg): agree. goal: single npm package that serves node (ESM + CJS) and edge (pure ESM). publish both builds in one tarball, expose with conditional exports, and ship a single flattened types file.

rick (runtime): strong constraint: edge entry must be ESM-only and zero-dep. no node builtins or CJS shims allowed. prefer an explicit "./edge" export that points to a vetted ESM bundle. add a build lint to fail on references to process/fs/Buffer.

emily (ts): TypeScript note: newer TS handles conditional exports for imports but types resolution can be flaky. we should publish dist/types/index.d.ts (flattened) and add typesVersions for older TS. also ensure declarations cover default import + CommonJS interop shapes.

nate (devex): example package.json export we tested:
```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "node": { "import": "./dist/esm/node.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/node.js" } },
  "./edge": { "import": "./dist/esm/edge.js" }
}
```

priya (pkg): add a minimal CJS wrapper file that does `module.exports = require('./dist/cjs/index.js')` to help older bundlers, but keep it tiny and dependency-free.

rick (runtime): CI additions: (a) edge smoke test that runs the ESM edge bundle in a Worker-like env (miniflare), (b) bundle validation with esbuild to detect forbidden globals, (c) auth/retry regression test that compares timings/behavior across builds.

deploy-bot: CI: redwood-sdk@edge-smoke build 7890 failed 2026-03-12T09:21:03Z — Worker runtime: Uncaught ReferenceError: require is not defined — logs: https://ci.internal/7890

emily (ts): on generating types: use api-extractor or rollup-plugin-dts to produce a single index.d.ts and run a small typing smoke test (`tsc --noEmit`) in CI against a sample consumer. include guidance for default/CJS interop in the d.ts.

nate (devex): decision: single tarball + clear exports (no edge-only dist-tag). keeps semver and rollbacks simple. next steps: @priya open RFC with package.json template + scripts, @emily types doc + d.ts template, @rick CI edge & bundle checks. i'll update onboarding examples to ESM-first and add a short CJS migration appendix. thanks all! :rocket
